title: Use one primary search location

statement.en: Aim to make the app's content searchable from one clearly identified location.
statement.ja: appのcontentを明確に識別できる1か所から検索できるようにする。

conditions: Distinct sections may also offer local search when it helps people focus on section-specific content.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Searching experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるSearchingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
